setup: SOURCE_ROOT="$(dirname "$(git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir)")"; if [ -f "$SOURCE_ROOT/.env" ]; then cp "$SOURCE_ROOT/.env" .env; fi
SOURCE_ROOT="$(dirname "$(git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir)")"; if [ -f "$SOURCE_ROOT/web/.env.local" ]; then cp "$SOURCE_ROOT/web/.env.local" web/.env.local; fi
